scope: Read-only readiness review of saved driver/model source; no inference, training or sealed-build modification.
finding: 32 generated tokens was a comparison-driver cap, not an architecture requirement. NativeTinyDecoder has a learned positional embedding table of 512 entries and explicitly checks sequence length <=512. Original inspected native profiles train with maxSeqLen512.

mechanicallyValidRevision.inputPolicy: Never truncate the prompt. Encode with the original tokenizer and framing, then reject an over-budget prompt explicitly. Keep model/tokenizer bytes unchanged.
mechanicallyValidRevision.conservativeBound: Total prompt plus generated tokens <=512 means every model forward pass remains inside the saved position table. This establishes mechanical validity, not learned coding capability.

shortPromptBudgets.learnedTokenizer: Measure actual SentencePiece IDs; do not estimate from bytes or compare token counts as equivalent amounts of text.
shortPromptBudgets.llama: A 512-new-token request fits well within the saved older Llama configuration for these short prompts; retain and report the original tokenizer/chat framing.

stopPolicy.endOfSequence: Stop only at the exact model/tokenizer EOS; retain EOS in raw token IDs and exclude it from rendered text.
stopPolicy.contextBudget: Distinguish exhausting available context from an explicit smaller output cap.
stopPolicy.deadline: Emit already-generated partial output and an explicit deadline stop instead of losing all content via an exception.
stopPolicy.repetition: Preserve repeated tokens/text. Report longest identical-token run and distinct token count as diagnostics; do not stop merely because a token repeats.
stopPolicy.nonfiniteLogits: Report as runtime failure with partial output; do not fabricate or normalize an answer.

computation: Existing native driver recomputes the complete prefix at every token. A larger output budget increases work; keep GPU runs serial and preserve a wall-time bound.

codingCases.note: All vectors checked independently from explicit expected values; input mutation and new-list identity are separate requirements.

checker.implementation: Restricted AST interpretation followed by actual CPython execution of the unchanged validated single function in an isolated child, with only len/range/set/list/enumerate exposed.
checker.limits: CPU soft2/hard3seconds; parent4seconds; interpreter10,000steps/vector; CPython100,000opcodes/vector with per-opcode local-value checks; source16KiB/AST512nodes/depth24/collections256/integer256bits.
checker.addressSpaceLimit: Attempted 512MiB AS rlimit is rejected by this macOS Python runtime; receipts explicitly record addressLimitInstalled=false. Independent AST/data/opcode/CPU/wall bounds remain active.
checker.interpretation: Unsupported grammar is distinct from wrong answers. Strip only an enclosing Python fence, preserve raw bytes and extracted code, report strict code-only compliance separately. A positive functional claim requires both interpreters and identical observations.
